description: Eirenan Dunadawn wears a deep green knee-length tunic with gold knotwork borders at the neckline, central front, cuffs and hem over a pale linen undertunic visible at the collar and cuffs. A heavy green fringed cloak includes a checked panel, knotwork edging and a round shoulder brooch. His decorated brown leather belt has a square buckle, a long hanging strap and a small pouch. Brown trousers, lower-leg wraps and brown leather boots complete the outfit. His curly hair is uncovered.
